immutable_snapshot.contains: The 36 manifest-bound artifacts, the accepted candidate manifest, and its pre-acceptance verification receipt.

frozen_scope: synthetic falsification fixtures and problem-suite specification v0.1
research question, estimands, hypotheses, primary endpoints and falsifiers
experiment matrix, baselines, ablations, fixed seeds and planned FFE budgets
success, failure, inconclusive and kill criteria
preregistration candidate v0.1 and reproducibility/ethics boundaries
freeze_effect.amendment_rule: Any change to a frozen artifact is a new version, must preserve this snapshot, must be entered in .light/deviations.md, and requires a new author authorization before confirmatory use.

explicitly_not_authorized: public release, preregistration-platform submission, manuscript submission or publication
performance, superiority, objective-novelty, causal, physical-validation or industrial-validation conclusions
